_comment: React Native runtime preset. Added in Phase 11, when apps/mobile became its
Extends the base rather than the Node preset: `module: nodenext` and
`types: ["node"]` describe a runtime this is not.
The module settings match what Metro actually does, and are not a free
react-native export is selected, and `module: preserve` leaves import
syntax for the bundler rather than rewriting it. An application extends
expo/tsconfig.base alongside this one, so a future SDK can add what it
needs without this preset having to know.
